title: Titanium Anode Basket (Expanded Mesh)
system: Electroplating Anode Baskets & Current Delivery Systems
function: Expanded mesh anode basket for electroplating
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for Titanium Anode Basket (Expanded Mesh) where formability and corrosion resistance are prioritized over absolute strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, Grade 2 CP-Ti forms a stable TiO₂ passive film that provides immunity to pitting in chloride environments up to 260°C. Its 345 MPa yield strength with 30% elongation makes it ideal for Expanded mesh anode basket for electroplating requiring cold forming or bending without cracking. This rationale is driven by expanded mesh anode basket for electroplating and fat life requirements.
process: CNC machining CP Ti for anode system geometry
TIG welding Ti filler with SPC sampling
Pickling and passivation with SPC sampling
Continuity test <1 mOhm with SPC sampling
surfaceTreatment: Platinum cladding 2.5um minimum via electrodeposition for stable catalytic surface in electrochemical cells — tailored for expanded mesh anode application
inspection: Adhesion tape ASTM D3359 (expanded mesh verified)
commonFailures: Precious metal drag-out >15% on complex racks - minimized by robotic extract 0.5m/min + air knife — critical for expanded mesh anode performance

faq.q: What bath chemistries is Titanium Anode Basket (Expanded Mesh) resistant to?
faq.a: Grade 2 CP-Ti used in Titanium Anode Basket (Expanded Mesh) resists attack in hexavalent chromium plating baths (250 g/L CrO₃), sulfuric acid anodizing (15-20% H₂SO₄), nickel sulfamate (300 g/L Ni), and cyanide-based solutions where steel racks corrode at >5 mm/month. Service life in these environments exceeds 12 months continuous immersion for expanded mesh anode.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Anode Basket (Expanded Mesh) orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Anode Basket (Expanded Mesh) is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Anode Basket (Expanded Mesh)?
faq.a: Each Titanium Anode Basket (Expanded Mesh) shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for expanded mesh anode.
